messages:
Rina Gomez: Hi team - need to remove an ex-partner from my benefits. separation date is 4/15. we had a separation agreement but no divorce yet. do i remove them now or wait? also worried about COBRA implications.

Mina Li (People Ops): if the ex-partner is no longer eligible (separation counts), you should submit a dependent removal QLE with the separation date 4/15. removal will be effective 4/15. we will notify carriers. if they elect COBRA, the carrier will reach out with an offer.

Rina Gomez: what's the documentation needed? separation agreement scan ok?

Mina Li (People Ops): yes a signed separation agreement or proof of separate residence works. checklist:
- PDF: signed separation agreement or court filing
- PDF: proof of separate residence (lease, utility) dated after separation date
Upload at https://app.redwood.com/benefits/upload select "Remove Dependent - QLE".

Rina Gomez: will payroll stop deducting premiums immediately?

Payroll - Priya: yes deductions stop as of effective removal date (4/15). we'll process the payroll adjustment on the next pay run. if the ex-partner later elects COBRA, carrier bills them directly.

Rina Gomez: ok thanks. i'll upload now.
